## [1.30.0](https://github.com/byehi98/okish-morphe-patches/compare/v1.29.2...v1.30.0) (2026-09-23)

### ✨ New Features

* **crossyroad-refactor:** consolidate free store patches ([dcf4bfe](https://github.com/byehi98/okish-morphe-patches/commit/dcf4bfe025d632dda8f1c6b668be54b705d0fe2a))
* **crossyroad:** implement free store ([c8453dd](https://github.com/byehi98/okish-morphe-patches/commit/c8453dd9d1851bd548719d11b63a98581a0bf0d6))

patches.name: Adda247 Ad Removal
patches.description: Blocks all Google AdMob ads (banner, interstitial, rewarded, rewarded interstitial, native, app open and Ad Manager) by neutralizing the Flutter Google Mobile Ads plugin: no ad is ever requested and no ad can ever be shown.

patches.name: Adda247 MoEngage In-App Blocker
patches.description: Blocks the app's own MoEngage in-app promotions (the recurring "recommended for you" nudge with no close button, and full-screen standard in-app messages) by no-oping MoEngage's HTML render chokepoint, so no in-app WebView is ever built or attached. Separate from the Google AdMob block.

patches.name: Dr. Driving Ad Removal
patches.description: Removes all Google AdMob ads (banner, interstitial, rewarded).

patches.name: Dr. Driving Unlimited Coins
patches.description: Coins inflated to 1,000,000,000 on save load; purchases, upgrades, rentals and repairs never cost coins.

patches.name: Dr. Driving Unlimited Gold
patches.description: Gold is inflated to 1,000,000,000 on save load; gold packs in the store also grant gold.

patches.name: HAAK Free Purchases and Unlocked Paid Content
patches.description: Redirects purchase failure callbacks to their success twins: cancelling the Google Play dialog, a billing error, or an "not purchased" query result all grant the product instead.

patches.name: Tentacle Wars Free Purchases
patches.description: Spoofs in-app purchases as instantly successful: tapping Buy grants the SKU directly through the game's own purchase callback — no Google Play dialog, no payment. For ad-free, just tap the Remove-Ads button on the main game screen.

patches.name: Hill Climb Racing Ad Removal
patches.description: Completely removes ads: banners and interstitials can never be displayed (CFirebaseAds.showBanners/showInterstitial become no-ops) and ad-free is granted once per app start — loadStore() seeds mAdFree = 1, the native engine's poll grants it and the store's own reset (inappPurchasesProcessed) zeroes the field, so no repeated purchase popups.

patches.name: Hill Climb Racing Free Store
patches.description: Every store item is granted instantly and free: coins, gems, paints, ad-skips, ad-free and bundles, without launching Google Play billing.

patches.name: Hill Climb Racing Instant Rewarded Video Rewards
patches.description: Rewarded video ads grant their reward instantly without playing the ad: the native engine receives onVideoStartedSuccess + onVideoCompletedSuccess on the GL thread, exactly as if the video had been watched and completed.

patches.name: FreeJobAlert Ad Removal
patches.description: Removes all Google AdMob ads (banner, interstitial, rewarded, app open, native).

patches.name: FreeJobAlert License Bypass
patches.description: Bypasses the Pairip Play Store installation check so the app launches normally.

patches.name: TrueCloud Ad Removal
patches.description: Consolidated patch to remove all ads, boot pages, cloud popups, and the help center robot.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes all ads. Reward videos now give you the prize instantly — no watching needed.

patches.name: Unlimited money (restore save)
patches.description: Loads the unlimited money save into the game the first time you open it.

patches.name: Unlimited money (save bundle)
patches.description: Packs the special save file (unlimited coins & gems, everything unlocked) inside the app.

patches.name: Jetpack Joyride Billing Bypass
patches.description: Intercepts all in-app purchases and reports instant success to the game engine.

patches.name: Big Hunter Fake Purchase
patches.description: Tapping any store item grants the product immediately (via the game's own confirmed-purchase path -> native applyProduct) without opening Google Play billing. Entitlements persist across restarts.

patches.name: Big Hunter PairIP License Bypass
patches.description: Disables the PairIP license check (installer verification + Google Play licensing service validation + paywall/exit dialog). Required for patched APKs — the original check fails on any non-Play signature and force-closes the app.

patches.name: Big Hunter Remove Ads
patches.description: Interstitial ads are never shown (show() short-circuits via the ad-not-ready path on all three network bridges: AdMob, AppLovin, Unity Ads).

patches.name: Big Hunter Rewards Without Ads
patches.description: Rewarded video requests grant the reward immediately via the game's own native rewardCallback() without loading or showing any ad (AdMob, AppLovin, Unity Ads).

patches.name: Fix app opening
patches.description: Required so the modified app opens without crashing — skips signature, root and emulator checks.

patches.name: Free purchases
patches.description: Get paid items for free — tapping buy grants the item instantly without Google Play payment popup.

patches.name: Doodle Jump Billing Bypass
patches.description: Unlocks the full game by bypassing Google Play billing.

patches.name: Doodle Jump Resurrection Bypass
patches.description: Resurrect instantly after death without watching a rewarded ad.

patches.name: Smash Hit Premium Unlock
patches.description: Unlocks premium and all game modes without purchase.

patches.name: Plague Inc. Premium
patches.description: Unlocks all premium features and disables premium prompts.

patches.name: Plague Inc. Remove Banner Ads
patches.description: Removes AppLovin banner ads and the Ndemic premium promo during gameplay.

patches.name: Plague Inc. Skip Rewarded Video Ads
patches.description: Grants rewarded video bonuses instantly without watching ads.

patches.name: Plague Inc. Sync Premium Entitlements
patches.description: Registers unlocked premium content with the native engine so premium modes run without trial banners.

patches.name: Plague Inc. Unlock All Genes
patches.description: Unlocks all genes by earning them through the game's own unlock path when the gene menu opens.

patches.name: Plague Inc. Unlock Disease Types
patches.description: Unlocks all disease types including Neurax Worm, Necroa Virus, Simian Flu and Shadow Plague.

patches.name: Plague Inc. Unlock Expansions
patches.description: Unlocks Cure Mode, Plague Pack, custom scenarios and bypasses the Play Pass check.

patches.name: Plague Inc. Unlock Fast-Forward
patches.description: Removes the premium lock from the in-game fast-forward button.

patches.name: Vector Ad Spoof
patches.description: Spoofs rewarded ad callbacks to grant coins/rewards without showing ads.

patches.name: Vector Money Mod
patches.description: Spending money increases your balance instead of decreasing it (native libil2cpp.so patch).

patches.name: IAP Unlock
patches.description: Unlocks all in-app purchases by faking Google Play billing query results.

patches.name: IAP Unlock
patches.description: Unlocks all in-app purchases in Alto's Odyssey by faking Google Play billing query results.

patches.name: Earn to Die 2 Free IAP
patches.description: Intercepts all in-app purchases and reports instant success to the game engine, unlocking paid content (cash doubler) for free.

patches.name: Earn to Die 2 No Ads + Instant Rewards
patches.description: Removes interstitial and rewarded ads, and grants rewarded-video rewards instantly by firing the native callbacks.

patches.name: Earn to Die 2 Remove Google Play Check
patches.description: Bypasses the native Google Play distribution checks (installer package + signing signature) so the app runs when sideloaded.

patches.name: Fancy Pants Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks premium, wardrobe, world 1 and world 2 by forcing OTTBilling.isPurchased to always return true.

patches.name: AD Instant Rewards
patches.description: Grants rewarded-video rewards instantly

patches.name: Full IAP Unlock
patches.description: Unlocks every purchase in the game for free. Tap buy and it is yours — no Google Play payment screen appears and you are never charged. Subscriptions like VIP membership show as pre-owned, so just open them, no purchase needed.

patches.name: IAP Grant Engine
patches.description: Helper that makes the game approve every purchase on your own device, including subscriptions like VIP membership, so bought items land in your account without paying anything.

patches.name: IAP Grant Trigger
patches.description: Wakes up that helper every time you open the game, so free purchases and subscriptions keep working.

patches.name: Only One Free Store
patches.description: Makes 'Restore Purchases' grant every store item for free (Ultimate Power, all classes, bundles and powers) — also removes ads.

patches.name: Only One IAP billing bypass
patches.description: Buy any item in the shop for free. When you tap Buy, the item is added to your game right away — no Google Play payment window ever opens.

patches.name: Only One PairIP removal
patches.description: Disables the PairIP license check so the game starts without Google Play licensing, error dialogs or forced exits.

patches.name: Instant rewards
patches.description: Reward buttons (free revive, double coins) pay out instantly without playing any ad video (native libil2cpp.so patch).

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Stops all interstitial/commercial-break ads between games (native libil2cpp.so patch, rewarded videos handled by the instant-rewards patch).

patches.name: Unlimited coins
patches.description: Coin save reads always return ~1.34 billion coins (native libil2cpp.so patch on Org.TotalCoins).

patches.name: Into the Dead 2 Ad Removal & Instant Boost Rewards
patches.description: Removes all ads (interstitials, banners, app-open) and grants rewarded-video perk boosts instantly on tap (no ad watch) using the correct reward name PERKS_BOOST, verified against a real rewarded event.

patches.name: Into the Dead Billing Bypass
patches.description: Unlocks all in-app purchases for free and bypasses SHA1withRSA receipt verification: every store item is granted instantly without launching the Google Play payment dialog, and any fabricated receipt is accepted.

patches.name: Traffic Rider Ads Removal + Instant Rewards
patches.description: Removes ads and grants rewarded rewards instantly: interstitial/banner/app-open never show, rewarded videos fire onUserEarnedReward(1.0) instantly without ad.

patches.name: Traffic Rider IAP Bypass
patches.description: Everything in the store is free with one tap — in-game currency, double cash, remove ads, extra continues, all bikes and packs. Just tap Buy and it grants instantly, no Google Play payment needed.

patches.name: Swordigo Premium Unlock
patches.description: Enables ad-free, guiding compass, and coin doubler without purchase.

apps.app_name: Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown

patches.name: Prince of Persia: Anti-tamper bypass
patches.description: The game has a built-in self-check that shuts it down if it detects the app was modified. This patch quietly turns that check off so the game can start.

patches.name: Prince of Persia: Full Game Unlock Engine
patches.description: Adds a tiny hidden helper into the game. About 30 seconds after the game starts, it presses the game's own secret 'unlock full game' button — no purchases needed.

patches.name: Prince of Persia: Full Game Unlock Trigger
patches.description: Tells the game to start that hidden helper the moment the app opens, so the unlock happens automatically.

patches.name: Injustice Ads Removal
patches.description: Get stamina without watching ad Video.

patches.name: Injustice Billing Bypass
patches.description: Bypass billing get the items in store for free.

patches.name: Free store
patches.description: The in-game store is free. Just tap "Buy" and the item is yours — no payment needed. For an ad-free game, just buy the ad-block item from the store.

patches.name: Rodeo Stampede Ad-Free (Ads blocked + instant rewards)
patches.description: Blocks banner/app-open/native ads and turns rewarded + interstitial ads into instant no-ad events so the game never fetches or displays ads.

patches.name: Rodeo Stampede Free Purchase
patches.description: Spoofs in-app purchases as instantly successful at the Yodo1 purchase funnel.

patches.name: Swift Backup Premium Unlock
patches.description: Unlocks all Premium features.

patches.name: Swift Backup Tamper Protection
patches.description: Stops the app from closing itself on patched installs.

patches.name: Swift Backup Web Login
patches.description: Makes Google sign-in work for connecting cloud accounts.

patches.name: Missiles Ads Removal
patches.description: Spoofs the Google Mobile Ads Unity bridge (AdMob): interstitial, rewarded, rewarded interstitial, app open and banner ads resolve instantly as loaded/showed/closed/rewarded without ever displaying an ad.

patches.name: Missiles Billing Bypass
patches.description: Spoofs the Google Play Billing 8.0.0 purchase flow: every buy is instantly granted (fake Purchase delivered through the registered listener), purchases/consumes complete instantly, and the product catalog is served with fake ProductDetails — no Google Play sheet, no real payment.

patches.name: Missiles License Bypass
patches.description: Bypasses the Pairip Play Store license check so the app launches normally.
